claim: Use the C simulator with frame-level hooks for analysis and censuses; the same job in Python is far slower.

evidence.text: rzx_census counts and finds the first frame of given PCs over a 90K-frame recording in ~4 min with the C simulator vs ~1 h in Python; a whole-RZX sheet capture through rzx.trace takes ~70 s for 90K frames.
evidence.quote: with the C simulator (~4 min for 90K frames vs ~1 h in Python): which quick run reaches a hook.

evidence.text: Graphics catalogue over the whole RZX (C simulator, graphics hashed at each frame end) takes 7.6 s.
evidence.quote: Graphics catalogue over the whole RZX (C simulator, gfx hashed at each frame end, 7.6 s)
